services.name: Sunset and Day Sails on Schooner Alabama
Day Sail
services.desc: The ultimate way to enjoy the surrounding beauty of Martha’s Vineyard is to sail onboard the Schooner Alabama. Duration 2 Hours About the Trip Scheduled regularly throughout the season, the Alabama sets sail from the Black Dog Wharf on three-hour long cruises. Join us onboard for an unforgettable afternoon or evening sail, where as a passenger you join the crew in the raising of the sails, manning the wheel with the captain or simply sitting back, enjoying the gorgeous scenery as you sip a glass of wine. services.name: Fireworks Cruise / Edgartown, July 4th
services.desc: About: The most sought after cruise of the season. See the fireworks in Edgartown aboard the Alabama. Guests are shuttled out to the schooner on a harbor launch @6pm and treated to a sail in Edgartown harbor and front row tickets to the fireworks while anchored near the lighthouse. Guests return immediately following fireworks @ 10pm Duration: 4

services.name: Fireworks Cruise / Oak Bluffs, August 21st
services.desc: About: The Oak Bluff’s Fireworks Cruise aboard the schooner Alabama is an experience not to be missed. Board the schooner in Vineyard Haven and enjoy a sunset sail aboard the Alabama as she transits from her mooring to the fireworks venue off of Oak Bluff’s village. After the sunset sail the Alabama will anchor in close proximity to the fireworks so that guests are treated to a fantastic vantage point. The schooner will be returning to her mooring immediately following the event where guests will disembark at the same location that they boarded – at The Black Dog Wharf.
